description: Multi-factor authentication with @auth0/nextjs-auth0 v4: redirect step-up via Universal Login (amr gating), server-side step-up on mfa_required, the MFA management API (getAuthenticators, enroll, challenge, verify), and reactive step-up via mfa.challengeWithPopup().
